title: New review on somatic variant calling beyond cancer
summary: Nick Taylor and Tim Hearn review how somatic variant callers, built to find cancer mutations, are being used to detect low-frequency variants elsewhere, such as mosaicism, mitochondrial heteroplasmy and cell-free DNA. Published in Mutation Research/Reviews in Mutation Research.

title: The science behind the trend for showering in the dark before bed
summary: Does showering in the dark help you sleep? Dim evening light and warm water may well help, but the trend itself hasn’t been tested.

title: What an ancient jellyfish can teach us about the evolution of sleep
summary: Jellyfish and sea anemones have sleep-like rest, during which their nerve cells repair DNA damage. What that suggests about why sleep evolved.

title: Why frequent nightmares may shorten your life by years
summary: A study linking frequent nightmares to faster biological ageing and earlier death, and why its findings need confirming before anyone acts on them.

title: From Scrooge to science: how dairy might disrupt your sleep and dreams
summary: Scrooge blamed his ghostly visions on cheese. A new study links dairy, and lactose intolerance in particular, to nightmares, though it can’t show cause and effect.

title: Why it can be harder to sleep during the summer – and what you can do about it
summary: Why light evenings and warm nights make it harder to sleep in summer, and simple ways to help: morning daylight, dim evenings, a dark bedroom and keeping cool.

title: Can we really resurrect extinct animals, or are we just creating hi-tech lookalikes?
summary: Whether de-extinction projects can really bring back lost species, or whether they produce modern animals engineered to look like them.

title: ‘Return’ of the dire wolf is an impressive feat of genetic engineering, not a reversal of extinction
summary: Colossal Biosciences’ “dire wolves” are grey wolves with edited genes: impressive genetic engineering, but not an extinct species brought back.

title: Ramadan: why napping might be especially beneficial during fasting
summary: How well-timed short naps can help people who are fasting stay alert, without disturbing their sleep at night.

title: Showcasing the early women in genetics at Newnham College
summary: Medical Genetics conference 2024 (ADMG24) was hosted at Newnham College on 1st July.

title: New projects registered with Genomics England
summary: Multiple new research projects registered covering Lynch Syndrome cancer and rheumatoid arthritis.
